Review the diff of commit 0d20337 ("feat: deliver reader account lifecycle with old-session rejection (ticket 35)") against its parent for STANDARDS compliance.

Diff command: `git diff ef99c26a8b3b019c51923150445cfc14c2db0db2...0d20337` (run inside C:\fixture\project)
Commit list: `git log ef99c26a8b3b019c51923150445cfc14c2db0db2..0d20337 --oneline`

Repo standards sources (read them):
- AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (root) — implementation conventions (one ticket = one commit; design baseline: tokens in .scratch/first-release-personal-technical-blog/design/tokens.md, typography.md; production code follows tokens/typography specs)
- CONTEXT.md
- docs/agents/domain.md (single-context layout)
- The changed code's surrounding style: Chinese comments explaining "why", existing modules src/lib/auth/session.ts, src/lib/readers.ts, src/lib/auth/guards.ts, src/components/site/account-menu.tsx, src/app/api/account/delete/route.ts, src/app/api/auth/session/route.ts, src/app/login/page.tsx, tests/acceptance/reader-account-lifecycle.test.mjs — note the ticket 34 delivery style: auth/session patterns, dynamic-import isolation, fail-closed, short-lived sessions, no session tables, ADR-0018/ADR-0031/ADR-0025 references.
- Design tokens rules: seal is the only accent; front pages do NOT use ok/bad status colors (admin only); small radii; no shadows; touch targets ≥44px; focus-visible 2px seal outline; contrast enforced by design/check-contrast.mjs.

Smell baseline (Fowler, Refactoring ch.3) — applies unless a documented repo standard overrides; each is a labelled judgement call, skip what tooling already enforces:
- Mysterious Name — name doesn't reveal what it does; rename.
- Duplicated Code — same logic shape in more than one hunk/file; extract.
- Feature Envy — method reaches into another object's data more than its own; move it.
- Data Clumps — same fields/params travelling together; bundle into a type.
- Primitive Obsession — primitive standing in for a domain concept; give it a type.
- Repeated Switches — same switch/if-cascade on same type recurs; polymorphism or shared map.
- Shotgun Surgery — one logical change forces scattered edits; gather into one module.
- Divergent Change — one file edited for several unrelated reasons; split.
- Speculative Generality — abstraction for needs the spec doesn't have; delete.
- Message Chains — long a.b().c().d() navigation; hide behind one method.
- Middle Man — class/function that mostly delegates; cut it.
- Refused Bequest — subclass ignoring most of what it inherits; use composition.

Report — per file/hunk where relevant: (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls — documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words. Return the report as your final message (it is not shown to the user directly, so include everything).

# AGENTS.md instructions for C:\fixture\project

> 本文件与项目根 `CLAUDE.md` 内容保持一致。**后续更新两者必须同时修改**：本文件被 git 跟踪并随仓库分发，CLAUDE.md 为本地指令文件（被 .gitignore 忽略）。

## Agent skills

### Issue tracker

Issues and specs are tracked as local Markdown files under `.scratch/<feature-slug>/`. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.

### Triage labels

Use the default triage labels: `needs-triage`, `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, and `wontfix`. See `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`.

### Domain docs

This repository uses a single-context domain layout with root `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/`. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.

## Design baseline for page implementations

Page implementations must build on the confirmed visual design in `.scratch/first-release-personal-technical-blog/`:

- **Authoritative specs:** `design/tokens.md` (design tokens — ultramarine accent, light/dark themes) and `design/typography.md` (Chinese long-form reading typography). Contrast is enforced by `design/check-contrast.mjs`; do not change token values without re-running it.
- **Production-stack prototype:** `prototype-next/` is a Next.js 15 + React 19 + TypeScript prototype rebuilt from the confirmed hi-fi static prototypes. Use it as the implementation skeleton for pages, navigation, theme, and the global search overlay. The static `prototypes/` remain the visual reference.
- **Confirmed interactions (do not regress):** project-case browser page `/projects` leading to per-case detail pages; global frosted-glass search overlay reachable from any page; independent front/admin theme keys; directory-style content lists.

Prototypes are design-validation artifacts: production code follows the tokens and typography specs, not the prototype HTML verbatim.

## Implementation commits

Complete one ticket at a time. After its acceptance criteria pass and review is complete, create one dedicated commit for that ticket before beginning the next unblocked ticket.
